reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 76,600.0. That is 504.0 points below spot, 1.21 hourly ATRs on a 415.12 reading, and it is deliberately placed BENEATH the 76,625 lower edge of the 76,750 bucket rather than above it. That bucket absorbed 2,549,781 USD across 269 filled orders in the last twenty-four hours, 248 of them forced sells, and it is the level that stopped this morning's decline. A stop resting inside a magnet of that size gets eaten by the magnet; a close beneath its far edge means the floor has actually failed rather than been probed. Below that gate the range thesis in this report is finished and the next shelf is 76,500 at 1,184,575 USD.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,560.0. That single level clears three things at once: the session high of 77,523.6, the 1H EMA200 at 77,547.08 and the 1H EMA50 at 77,542.73. It is 456.0 points above spot, 1.10 hourly ATRs. Midday set its add gate at 77,480.0 and the tape traded 43.6 points through it on a wick while the highest settled hourly close reached only 77,399.9 - eighty points short. The gate did its job and the reclaim it was guarding against turned out to be exactly the noise it was designed to filter. This session raises the bar rather than lowering it, because the thing that has to be proved is now larger: price is back below all four 15m EMAs and all four 1H EMAs.

decisionBox.changed: The reclaim failed and the stance reverses with it. Midday read ADD at 77,350.1 on price back above the 15m EMA20, EMA50 and EMA100 and 117.93 points above the 1H EMA20, with the 1H MACD histogram freshly positive and a six-hour liquidation window running 1.96-to-1 in favour of forced buying. Seven hours later price is 77,104.0 and BELOW all four 15m EMAs and BELOW all four 1H EMAs; 15m RSI has slid from 54.50 to 43.80 and the 15m MACD histogram has rolled from +3.71 to -17.54. The one piece that has not broken is the 1H MACD histogram at +52.52, still positive and still above its signal - which is why this is a tilt and not a reversal call. Underneath, the twenty-four-hour realized-liquidation tape is 5,791,413 USD of LONG liquidations against 2,999,169 USD of short, and the single largest cluster on the board, 2,549,781 USD at 76,750, sits 354.0 points below spot. Open interest fell 24,595,820 USD from midday to 2,239,445,191.51 while price fell 246.1 points, which is orderly deleveraging rather than a flush. The stance moves from ADD to a modest REDUCE: a 12 percent trim of the spot sleeve to rebuild dry powder ahead of the overnight gap, with a resting stop written at 76,600.0. No leverage in either direction - two sessions this week paid for that lesson.

overnightRisk: The gap to the next report is short by this desk's standards, roughly six hours twenty minutes to the 02:00 COT midnight run, but it is the thinnest six hours of the day and the tape has already gone quiet: the last six hours produced only twelve filled liquidations totalling 50,593 USD, against 404 fills in the six hours before the midday report. Thin books plus a 2,549,781 USD long-liquidation magnet 354.0 points below spot is the specific combination that turns a 0.3 percent drift into a 1.5 percent air pocket, because there is nothing resting between 77,000 and 76,750 to absorb it. Three concrete catalysts sit inside the window. First, the US spot-ETF tape: Farside's 02 September row is still incomplete at -14.3m with IBIT, ARKB, BTCO and BTCW yet to report, and IBIT alone printed -201.2m on 01 September - a second large IBIT outflow landing overnight would confirm a two-day institutional exit rather than a one-day blip. Second, the 08:00 UTC funding settlement at +0.0000618468328616, which is up from midday's +0.0000525 even as price fell; longs paying more into a falling tape while the OKX long/short account ratio sits at 1.30 is crowding that has not yet been cleared, and it clears fastest through the magnet below. Third, the Asian cash open around 19:00 UTC-plus, with JPXN having closed +0.55 percent and the dollar index soft at 99.555 - a supportive backdrop, but the smallest of the three effects. The asymmetry is downward and the only protection that works while nobody is watching is a resting order, which is why stopOrder.recommended is true at 76,600.0 - below the magnet's far edge, not inside it.

liquidation.note: 2,549,781 USD across 269 filled orders inside the 76,625-76,875 bucket, 248 forced sells against 21 buys - by a wide margin the largest cluster on the twenty-four-hour board and 1.8 times the next one. It sits 354.0 points BELOW spot. This is the shelf where the morning decline stopped and the midday reversal started, so it has already proved it can hold once; the point of the reduceIf gate at 76,600.0 is that a settled close beneath its far edge means it has stopped holding.

1,426,695 USD across 289 fills inside the 76,875-77,125 bucket, 213 sells and 76 buys - the most genuinely two-way shelf on the board and the one spot is standing on, 104.0 points below the 77,104.0 print. Two-way liquidation at one price is what a contested level looks like. The session low since the midday report, 76,978.2, is inside this bucket, and the last six hours put eight more forced sells worth 30,377 USD into it.

1,391,067 USD across 134 fills inside the 77,375-77,625 bucket, 133 of them BUYS - short liquidations, forced buy-ins, the cleanest one-way shelf on the board. It brackets the session high of 77,523.6, the 1H EMA50 at 77,542.73, the 1H EMA200 at 77,547.08 and the 15m EMA200 at 77,534.71. Because the shorts stacked here were already bought in during the midday squeeze, there is less fuel left to carry a second push through it - which is part of why the addIf gate is set above it at 77,560.0 rather than at it.

1,184,575 USD across 161 fills inside the 76,375-76,625 bucket, every single one a SELL. One-way long liquidation with no offsetting buyers is the signature of an air pocket rather than a level, and it is the shelf directly beneath the 76,750 magnet. If the reduceIf gate at 76,600.0 settles through, this is what the tape falls into next.

1,090,303 USD across 243 fills inside the 77,125-77,375 bucket, 174 buys and 69 sells. It is the nearest cluster above spot at 146.0 points, and it contains both the 1H EMA20 at 77,264.65 and the 15m EMA100 at 77,294.86. Reclaiming this bucket on a settled hourly close is the first honest sign that the bearish tilt in this report is wrong.

691,979 USD across 104 fills inside the 76,125-76,375 bucket, all of them SELLS. It brackets the 24h low of 76,261.0, which is also this report's invalidation level. Reaching it would mean the whole 76,261.0-77,788.1 day range has been resolved to the downside.

456,180 USD across 60 fills, all BUYS, bracketing the 24h high of 77,788.1. It is 646.0 points above spot, 1.56 hourly ATRs away, and nothing in this session's data argues the tape gets there before the midnight report.

calibration.rollingRecord: MIDDAY GRADED: THE GATES WERE RIGHT AGAIN AND THE DISCRETIONARY TRADE WAS WRONG AGAIN - THREE SESSIONS RUNNING. Midday set the reduce gate at 76,850.0 requiring a settled 1H close, with price at 77,350.1. The session low since was 76,978.2, so price never came within 128.2 points of the level and the gate is correctly UNFIRED. The add gate at 77,480.0 is also correctly unfired, and this one is the instructive half: the session high of 77,523.6 traded 43.6 points THROUGH it on a wick, but the highest settled hourly close was 77,399.9, still 80.1 points short. Midday explicitly widened that gate to 0.50 of an hourly ATR above the 1H EMA20, more than three times the 0.15 ATR buffer morning used, on the reasoning that thin reclaims of that average are noise. The tape then produced exactly such a thin reclaim, and the widened gate filtered it out. That is the first design decision in four sessions that demonstrably earned its keep. The invalidation at 76,261.0 was never approached. What lost money, again, was the discretionary act: midday bought 0.00025856 BTC of spot at 77,350.1 as an ADD on the unconfirmed reclaim, and that tranche is now 246.1 points underwater, roughly -0.06 USDT. Small, and far smaller than the two leveraged shorts that preceded it - the instrument choice was right even though the timing was not. The pattern across four sessions is now unambiguous: the RULE-BASED settled-close gates have been correct every single time, and every DISCRETIONARY entry taken between them has lost money. This session responds by acting only in the direction the gates already point, and in size small enough that being wrong costs almost nothing.
calibration.note: priorReduceFired is False and unambiguously so - price never traded within 128.2 points of 76,850.0 on either a touch or a settled-close definition, the second consecutive session where the two definitions agree. actingHelped is False: midday's one discretionary act, the 0.00025856 BTC spot add at 77,350.1, is underwater by 246.1 points at the 77,104.0 mark. The mitigating detail is that it was expressed in spot rather than leverage, so the loss is roughly -0.06 USDT against -0.30 for morning's futures short and -0.43 for midnight's.
